theorem lg_target {A : Type u_1} [AddMonoid A] [StarAddMonoid A] {r : A → A → Prop} (hr : ∀ (a b : A), r a b → r (star a) (star b)) ⦃a b : A⦄ : AddConGen.Rel r a b → AddConGen.Rel r (star a) (star b) := by
  induction h using AddConGen.Rel.induction
  case refl => exact hr a b h
  case add c d e f hc hd he hf =>
    have h1 : AddConGen.Rel r c e := by induction hc using AddConGen.Rel.induction
    have h2 : AddConGen.Rel r d f := by induction hd using AddConGen.Rel.induction
    have h3 : AddConGen.Rel r (star c) (star e) := by induction h1 using AddConGen.Rel.induction
    have h4 : AddConGen.Rel r (star d) (star f) := by induction h2 using AddConGen.Rel.induction
    exact AddConGen.Rel.add h3 h4
